query: 哪些员工的订单总金额高于全体员工的平均订单总金额？

outcome.sql: WITH "emp_totals" AS (SELECT "e"."emp_id" AS "emp_id", "e"."emp_name" AS "emp_name", SUM("o"."amount") AS "total_amount" FROM "public"."emp" "e" INNER JOIN "public"."orders" "o" ON "e"."emp_id" = "o"."emp_id" GROUP BY "e"."emp_id", "e"."emp_name"), "avg_total" AS (SELECT AVG("total_amount") AS "avg_amount" FROM "emp_totals") SELECT "t"."emp_id" AS "emp_id", "t"."emp_name" AS "emp_name", "t"."total_amount" AS "total_amount", ROUND("a"."avg_amount", 2) AS "avg_total_amount" FROM "emp_totals" "t" CROSS JOIN "avg_total" "a" WHERE "t"."total_amount" > "a"."avg_amount" ORDER BY "t"."total_amount" DESC LIMIT 40
